description.en: About 32.2K general-science claims, balanced across Supported, Refuted and Not-Enough-Info, generated automatically from SciQ crowd-sourced exam questions by the Multi2Claim pipeline (EACL 2023). Annotators judged a quarter of claims answerable without the evidence, so part of a score can come from world knowledge rather than verification. Only 50 examples are public; the full set is on request.
